verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address - VideoShorts
verifyEmail.title: Welcome to VideoShorts!
verifyEmail.body: Please verify your email address by clicking the button below:
verifyEmail.footer: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your password - VideoShorts
passwordReset.title: Password Reset Request
passwordReset.body: Click the button below to reset your password:
passwordReset.footer: This link will expire in 1 hour. If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to VideoShorts!
welcome.title: Welcome to VideoShorts!
welcome.body1: Thank you for verifying your email. Your account is now fully activated.
welcome.body2: You can now start creating and sharing short videos with the world.
welcome.footer: If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our support team.

companyVerified.subject: Company Verified - VideoShorts
companyVerified.title: Company Verified
companyVerified.footer: You can now access all company features.

companyRejected.subject: Company Verification Rejected - VideoShorts
companyRejected.title: Company Verification Rejected
companyRejected.body: Your company {{companyName}} verification has been rejected.
companyRejected.footer: Please contact support if you have questions.

companyDeleted.subject: Company Deleted - VideoShorts
companyDeleted.title: Your company has been deleted
companyDeleted.body: Company {{companyName}} has been deleted from our service by an administrator.
companyDeleted.footer: If you believe this is a mistake, please contact support.
